NATIONAL FOREWORD
This Indian Standard (First Revision) is identical to ISO 10576 : 2022 'Statistical methods - Guidelines for the evaluation of conformity with specified requirements' issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO), was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on the recommendation of the Statistical Methods for Quality, Data Analysis and Reliability Sectional Committee and approval of the Management and Systems Division Council.
This Indian Standard was first published in the year 2014 as IS 16179 (Part 1) : 2014 and was identical adoption of ISO 10576-1 : 2003 'Statistical methods - Guidelines for the evaluation of conformity with specified requirements'
Subsequently ISO 10576-1 : 2003 was superseded by ISO 10576 : 2022 and accordingly revision of IS 16179 (Part 1) : 2014 was taken up to align it with the latest version of ISO 10576. The earlier version provided guidelines for conformity assessment using measurement results and uncertainty with singlelaboratory examples. It explained decision rules, handling limits, and basic statistical testing, with examples based on a single lab. The present adoption supersedes IS 16179 (Part 1) : 2014 and this revision includes laboratory-to-laboratory variability in the uncertainty calculation, see Annex B.
The text of the International Standard has been approved as suitable for publication as an Indian Standard without deviations. Certain conventions are, however, not identical to those used in Indian Standards. Attention is particularly drawn to the following:
a) Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard'; and
b) Comma (,) has been used as a decimal marker while in Indian Standards, the current practice is to use a point (.) as the decimal marker.
